1.why: All screens use a clean sans-serif typeface with visibly generous letter and line spacing in headings, labels, and inputs.

2.why: No italics, all-caps, or dense text blocks appear anywhere; all copy is short single lines or brief sentences.

3.why: The layout is a narrow, single-column card with large inputs and buttons that fits a mobile viewport well, though only desktop-width screenshots are shown.

4.why: Instructions such as 'Sign in to begin. Take your time.' and 'Enter the same contact details again.' are short and plain, but the raw error 'Invalid array length' is jargon.

5.why: Every input shows an example, both as placeholder text ('name@example.com', '07123 456789') and as explicit 'Demo:' values beneath the fields.

6.why: No screen contains more than two short sentences of instruction; progress never depends on reading a long passage.

7.why: No copy-to-clipboard control is visible on any screen, and the flow errors out before any codes or secrets are displayed.

8.why: No QR code or any alternative to manual entry appears; the flow stalls at identity confirmation with 'Invalid array length' and never reaches authenticator setup.

9.why: Standard email, phone, and password inputs are shown, but there is no observable evidence (attributes, prompts, or UI) confirming autofill or password manager support.

10.why: Each screen shows 'Step X of 6' with a step name at top and a single large high-contrast blue primary button.

11.why: Each screen offers exactly one primary action ('Sign in and continue', 'Confirm my identity') with no competing buttons.

12.why: Sign-in is confirmed plainly ('You are signed in. Next, confirm your identity.'), but after the next action the system only shows the cryptic 'Invalid array length' with no statement of what happened or what comes next.

13.why: Retry is explicitly supported ('You can correct and retry these details', 'You can retry any step'), but no reveal/hide or re-request code options are observed because the flow never reaches a code step.

14.why: The only error shown is 'Invalid array length', a raw technical message that states neither the problem in user terms nor how to fix it.

15.why: The interface explicitly states 'No reading timer. You can retry any step.' and no countdown or time limit appears on any screen.
